portable_choices: Arrays describe their terminal type and all logical dimensions; transparent aliases use canonical resolved names; JOINTPOS uses JOINTPOS9
Any missing data leaf marks an aggregate missing, without changing direct UNINIT exclusions
BYTE has no initialization tracking, so its flag is FALSE even while unknown contents remain unreadable
FILE flag follows open state; PATH flag inspects supplied header/nodes, with empty headerless PATH initialized
QUEUE_TYPE metadata returns unsupported-type status 4 because no reviewed type code is supplied
Lists sort by program/name, support star-only patterns, clear unused slots on success and preserve all outputs except status on failure
